facts.business: Century Enka Limited manufactures nylon tyre cord fabric, nylon filament yarn, and polyester filament yarn at its plants in Pune (Maharashtra) and Bharuch (Gujarat).

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital investments on energy conservation equipment

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 45(b) regarding Excise department demand of Rs 22,927 lacs (2013), CESTAT order (2019), Commissioner re-determination to Rs 730 lacs (2020), Department appeal pending at Supreme Court, Company appeal pending, Rs 730 lacs deposited under protest, no provision considered necessary based on legal advice.

key_risks: Excise duty demand contingency (Rs 730 lacs confirmed, appeal pending at Supreme Court)
Foreign currency exposure on imports (caprolactam, no hedging available for main raw material)
Commodity price risk on caprolactam (main raw material, no hedging facility available)
Energy cost volatility (mitigated by conservation measures and biomass heaters)
facts.related_party_note: No materially significant related party transactions during FY 2025-26 that could pose potential conflict with Company interests. Policy available at https://www.centuryenka.com/pdf/policies/policy-on-related-party-transactions.pdf
